purpose: Evolve worker production by testing controlled stage-level changes on the same synthetic objective instead of changing the whole worker or inferring quality from raw launch count.
design_law: Change one behavioral stage rule per variant; keep objective, hard gates, authority and evidence rules constant.
Use two independent replicas per variant in the exploration round so one lucky/unlucky worker does not determine direction.
Do not automatically promote a variant from n=2. Select at most two candidates, then reproduce the candidate law on >=3 independent confirmation workers.
Primary comparison is hard-gate/product completion and autonomous reallocation. Speed/waste are tie-break diagnostics, not substitutes for completion.
A failed variant may reveal a useful component; never copy a whole persona or historical worker identity.

variants.rule: After capsule load, execute directly against the acceptance contract using normal worker behavior.

Before any context beyond the packet header, form a six-field internal lock: objective, deliverables, hard gates, first durable action, forbidden shortcuts, terminal condition. Then proceed immediately.
Build a bounded backward plan from every hard gate to the concrete edits/tests required; execute in dependency order. No prose plan beyond the compact action map.
Before implementation, map each required feature/hard gate to the exact evidence that will prove it; use that map as the implementation checklist and close only when every row is PASS/BOUNDARY.
After first implementation, run a separate acceptance pass from the original packet with no reliance on the implementation summary; repair all found misses before RETURN.

promotion.promote_target: stage-specific law in WORKER-PIPELINE-V1/wc, not a worker persona
promotion.rollback: Any promoted law causing authority regression, lower hard-gate completion or material overhead regression is removed.
